+"""RoboTwin 2.0 place_object_basket controller (eai-standard/2.1).
+
+This is the session script used to control one live episode.  It deliberately
+starts from the robot's measured pose and logs every action and resulting
+camera frame under /app/output/steps.
+"""
+import os
+import sys
+import json
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver
+
+r = Robot()
+step_no = 0
+os.makedirs("/app/output/steps", exist_ok=True)
+
+def observe(depth=False):
+    return r.get_obs(include_depth=depth, video="none")
+
+def move(left=None, right=None, left_grip=None, right_grip=None, note=""):
+    """Move either/both ee frames; unspecified arms and grippers hold measured commands."""
+    global step_no
+    o = observe()
+    p = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+    l = list(p[14:21]) + [float(p[28] if left_grip is None else left_grip)]
+    rr = list(p[21:28]) + [float(p[29] if right_grip is None else right_grip)]
+    if left is not None:
+        l[:7] = list(left)
+    if right is not None:
+        rr[:7] = list(right)
+    action = np.asarray(l + rr, dtype=np.float32)
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", action, video="mp4", note=note)
+    step_no += 1
+    out = f"/app/output/steps/{step_no:02d}"
+    res.save(out)
+    print(json.dumps({"step": step_no, "note": note, "result": res.meta,
+                      "ee_pose": res.proprio[-1, 14:28].tolist() if res.proprio is not None else None,
+                      "gripper_meas": res.proprio[-1, 6:7].tolist() + res.proprio[-1, 13:14].tolist() if res.proprio is not None else None,
+                      "saved": out}, default=str), flush=True)
+    return res
+
+def snapshot(name="snapshot"):
+    o = r.get_obs(video="none")
+    os.makedirs("/app/output/steps", exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, frame in o.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(f"/app/output/steps/{name}_{cam}.jpg")
+    print(json.dumps({"snapshot": name, "time_left_s": o.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+                      "now": o.meta["proprio"]["now"]}, default=str), flush=True)
+    return o
+
+print("Connected", json.dumps({"protocol": r.spec()["protocol"], "budget": r.spec()["budget"]}), flush=True)
+snapshot("start")
*** End Patch";

import os
import sys
import json
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

r = Robot()
step_no = 0
os.makedirs("/app/output/steps", exist_ok=True)

def observe(depth=False):
    return r.get_obs(include_depth=depth, video="none")

def move(left=None, right=None, left_grip=None, right_grip=None, note=""):
    """Move either/both ee frames; unspecified arms and grippers hold measured commands."""
    global step_no
    o = observe()
    p = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
    l = list(p[14:21]) + [float(p[28] if left_grip is None else left_grip)]
    rr = list(p[21:28]) + [float(p[29] if right_grip is None else right_grip)]
    if left is not None:
        l[:7] = list(left)
    if right is not None:
        rr[:7] = list(right)
    action = np.asarray(l + rr, dtype=np.float32)
    res = r.submit("ee_pose", action, video="mp4", note=note)
    step_no += 1
    out = f"/app/output/steps/{step_no:02d}"
    res.save(out)
    print(json.dumps({"step": step_no, "note": note, "result": res.meta,
                      "ee_pose": res.proprio[-1, 14:28].tolist() if res.proprio is not None else None,
                      "gripper_meas": res.proprio[-1, 6:7].tolist() + res.proprio[-1, 13:14].tolist() if res.proprio is not None else None,
                      "saved": out}, default=str), flush=True)
    return res

    o = r.get_obs(video="none")
    os.makedirs("/app/output/steps", exist_ok=True)
    for cam, frame in o.last.items():

    print(json.dumps({"snapshot": name, "time_left_s": o.meta.get("time_left_s"),
                      "now": o.meta["proprio"]["now"]}, default=str), flush=True)
    return o
